Get Ready to Apply
Beginning your application to the Medical University of South Carolina is an exciting step toward advancing your future in healthcare, research, or health professions education. Below, you'll find essential information you need to understand before applying, which will help you navigate the application process with confidence and clarity.
Apply Now
Begin your application, submit your materials, and access your personalized applicant portal.
Check My Application Status
View your application progress, upload required documents, track recommendations, and review your admission decision.
Application Fee Details
Each MUSC application requires a non-refundable processing fee. Be sure to review the cost structure and understand when additional fees may apply for program changes or deferrals.
Sending Test Scores
Some MUSC programs require official test scores as part of the application. Learn how to submit GRE, MCAT, DAT, or other required scores directly from testing agencies to ensure timely processing.
Transcript Requirements
Learn what documents are needed and when to submit them to avoid delays in application review.
Understanding SC Residency
Residency classification can affect tuition and scholarship eligibility. If you're unsure whether you qualify as a South Carolina resident for tuition purposes, review the guidelines and documentation requirements before submitting your application.
